name: validate_json
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json
qa=json.load(open("qa/QA.json",encoding="utf-8"))
cl=json.load(open("CLAIMS.json",encoding="utf-8"))
print("QA keys",list(qa.keys()))
print("QA checks",len(qa["checks"]))
for c in qa["checks"]:
    print(c["name"],c["pass"],c["result"][:120])
print("CLAIMS",len(cl["claims"]))
print("first",cl["claims"][0])
print("last",cl["claims"][-1])
